info.title: statseat API
info.description: Contract between the statseat backend and the PWA (mock implementation with fake data). match_id and the ticket tier are derived from the ticket token server-side. Tiers: silver = Casual only; gold = Analyst with switch to Casual; demo = gold + Inspector + phase panel (also for the judges). One device per ticket except demo. Payloads built from the match carry as_of_s (no look-ahead). All names are fictional (universe MERIDIA-1.0).

get.description:
The final report in PDF, built by the server (L-2g, v0.2.6): the Recap's summary (computed by the code),
its key moments and the Data & Statistics of the same version, with the fan's favourite players. Open after the
final whistle (423 before), English only.
A club's crest (M-1, synthetic/crests/). Public, like any image of the app: no token needed.

post.description: A new game against the fan-bot (M-3, app/games/ttt.py): the match's grid, 20 s per turn, 10 minutes.

get.description: The game now (v0.3.1): after the 20 s the fan has lost the turn and the bot has played.

post.description: The next of the session's 5 questions (M-3, app/games/guess.py): always the 'career' version.

as_of_s.description: Playback time (seconds since kick-off, first-half added time included) up to which frames and events were used; nothing after this instant (no look-ahead, S-7)

shot_speed.title: Shot Speed
shot_speed.description: The hardest shot of each team

ppda.title: Ppda
ppda.description: Analyst only: passes per defensive action

MatchStats.title: MatchStats
MatchStats.description:
Data & Statistics, from kick-off to the end (v0.2.5): `scope` is `live` during play (numbers up to `as_of_s`),
`first_half` at half-time, `full_match` after the final whistle. Fields marked 'Analyst only' are null in Casual
mode. v0.3.0 follows the metric decisions of Materials/METRICS.md; the app calls the two modes Fan (casual) and
Analyst (analyst). The tables come first, in the order of `DATA_STATS_TABLES`, then the charts.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Deterministic function that produced the value

MetricMethod.title: MetricMethod
MetricMethod.description: Inspector 'How it's computed' entry for one metric.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Field name in the payload, e.g. distance_covered, xg, momentum

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Short English reason, e.g. 'needs tracking frames (source fake has events only)'

available_from_minute.title: Available From Minute
available_from_minute.description: Match minute from which the metric appears, e.g. 5 (v0.3.0): the app shows 'Available from 5''. null = not for this source, or not computed yet: the app hides the card

MetricUnavailable.title: MetricUnavailable
MetricUnavailable.description: A metric that is null (or an empty list) in this payload, and why. The app shows the reason, never a number.

Momentum.title: Momentum
Momentum.description:
Who is pushing (METRICS.md §13): value in [-1, 1] over the last 5 minutes, positive = home team. `series`: one
point per minute, a single signed value drawn as an area above or below the axis.

series.title: Series
series.description: One point per minute and team (mirror chart)

PeakIntensity.title: PeakIntensity
PeakIntensity.description:
Peak intensity (METRICS.md §4, v0.3.0): rolling 5-minute window, step 1 s, metres per minute per player; a team
is the mean of its outfield players on the pitch. `series` feeds the mirror chart, one point per minute.

PickerPlayer.title: PickerPlayer
PickerPlayer.description: Player picker entry: only name, team and shirt number (no careers, no nationality).

distance.description: null when the source has no tracking

passes.title: Passes
passes.description: null when the source has no pass events

acceleration_load_series.title: Acceleration Load Series
acceleration_load_series.description: Analyst only: km/h per minute, 5-minute blocks

PlayerFocus.title: PlayerFocus
PlayerFocus.description:
Card of a favourite player (at most 3), the same in Data & Statistics, Recap and the PDF (v0.3.0). The fields
marked 'Analyst only' are null in Casual.

players.title: Players
players.description: The 50 players of the two squads

PlayerRow.title: PlayerRow
PlayerRow.description:
One row of the Analyst table of all players (v0.3.0). null = not available for this source, or not computed
yet (see `unavailable`).

Possession.title: Possession
Possession.description: Share of the live-ball time with the ball: one bar, the same in both versions (v0.3.0: no 5-minute series).

favourite_player_ids.title: Favourite Player Ids
favourite_player_ids.description: Player ids of this match, at most 3, no repeats

favourites_locked.title: Favourites Locked
favourites_locked.description: True once the fan has confirmed exactly 3 favourites; then they can no longer change (409 favourites_locked)

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP 47 tag; Archie answers in any language, UI in en/it

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.description:
Mode, favourite players and language of the session. The favourites are at most 3 (v0.2.6): the fan confirms
exactly 3 with `favourites_locked = true`, and after that the server refuses any change to them (409).

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric of METRICHE.md the answer comes from

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Summary written by the code from the match numbers, no model (Casual: score and scorers; Analyst: also shots and possession)

favourite_players.title: Favourite Players
favourite_players.description: The same Player Focus cards as Data & Statistics (v0.3.0)

Reliability.title: Reliability
Reliability.description:
Share of the time actually measured by the tracking (gaps not counted) and its symbol (v0.3.0): high at least
95 %, medium 85-95 %, low below 85 %. The app shows only the symbol; the Inspector explains it.

ReliabilityLevel.title: ReliabilityLevel
ReliabilityLevel.description: Symbol next to a tracking-based number (v0.3.0): high ●, medium ◐, low ○.

unlocks_at_phase.description: Next phase in which it opens, if locked

tier.description: From the ticket, server-side; the client cannot change it

allowed_modes.title: Allowed Modes
allowed_modes.description: Modes this tier may use: silver [casual]; others [analyst, casual]

demo_panel_enabled.title: Demo Panel Enabled
demo_panel_enabled.description: True only for demo tickets (phase jumps)

multi_device.title: Multi Device

preferences.description: preferences.mode is always one of allowed_modes

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Map symbols (v0.3.0): goal filled, woodwork ×, every other shot hollow

speed_kmh.title: Speed Kmh
speed_kmh.description: Ball speed of the strike; null for headers

ShotSpeed.title: ShotSpeed
ShotSpeed.description: The hardest shot of a team (headers excluded, v0.3.0).

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: null = the team; set for a favourite player (v0.3.0)

SpeedZones.title: SpeedZones
SpeedZones.description: Distance per FIFA speed zone (0-7, 7-15, 15-20, 20-25, 25+ km/h). Analyst only.

source.title: Source
source.description: MATCH_SOURCE used by the engine, e.g. fake, synthetic:SYN-001

TeamColours.title: TeamColours
TeamColours.description:
Club colours (home kit). The app picks the team's mark from these and switches to `away_kit` when the two
teams' colours are too similar (v0.2.4).

woodwork.title: Woodwork
woodwork.description: Shots off the post or the bar, never on target (v0.3.0)

sprints.title: Sprints
sprints.description: Sprints of the team; null when the source has no tracking

tackles.title: Tackles
tackles.description: Tackles won; null when the source has no duel events

ball_recoveries.title: Ball Recoveries
ball_recoveries.description: null when the source has no recovery events

distance.description: Outfield players only (goalkeepers appear as players)

TeamId.title: TeamId
TeamId.description: Team ids of the match, as in synthetic/<match_id>/match_info.json.

most_touches.title: Most Touches
most_touches.description: The 3 players with the most touches (METRICS.md §24)

TeamLeaders.title: TeamLeaders
TeamLeaders.description: Who leads each team, for the Fan tables (v0.3.0).

total_kmh.title: Total Kmh
total_kmh.description: Sum over the outfield players of the absolute changes of speed, km/h

TeamMeasure.title: TeamMeasure
TeamMeasure.description: A per-team value with its reliability symbol (tracking-based metrics, v0.3.0).

long_balls.title: Long Balls
long_balls.description: Analyst only: successful passes of 32 m or more (v0.3.0)

TeamPeak.title: TeamPeak
TeamPeak.description: A team's most intense 5 minutes: mean metres per minute of its outfield players on the pitch.

TeamSeries.title: TeamSeries
TeamSeries.description: One team's series over time: the home team is drawn above the axis and the away team below (mirror chart).

TeamShots.title: TeamShots
TeamShots.description: Penalties count in shots, shots on target and goals; on target = goals + saves (METRICS.md §8).

perks.title: Perks
perks.description: Short English lines for the My ticket page

TicketFeatures.title: TicketFeatures
TicketFeatures.description: What the tier unlocks (the same rules the server enforces).

url.title: Url
url.description: API path that serves the image of this session's ticket

path.title: Path
path.description: Source file in the repo, e.g. synthetic/SYN-001/tickets/<ticket_id>.svg

available.title: Available
available.description: False until the ticket generator (S-4) has written the file

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: Public id printed on the ticket, e.g. TKT-SYN001-G-0001 (not the code)

seat.description: null for passes without a seat (demo)

TicketInfo.title: TicketInfo
TicketInfo.description: The My ticket page. Holder-agnostic: no name, e-mail or other personal data; never the code itself.

TicketSeat.title: TicketSeat
TicketSeat.description: Seat from the stadium of synthetic/universe (stands, sectors, gates). No personal data.

TicketTier.title: TicketTier

TopSpeed.description: Fan: the fastest player of each team; Analyst: up to 5 per team (v0.3.0).

ends_at.title: Ends At
ends_at.description: End of the 10 minutes: a draw without three in a row (v0.3.1)

reason.title: Reason

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: null = the team; set for a favourite player (v0.3.0)

ZoneMap.title: ZoneMap
ZoneMap.description:
Heatmap of play zones: rows x cols cells over the pitch, share of time (%), attacking left to right. Analyst
only.
